title: R/W Bit Check in 10-bit Addressing Mode

c.v: controller performs a check on the first byte, which consists of slave_addr_first_7bits and a R/W bit.
When the R/W bit does not indicate a WRITE operation, i.e., not in line with the I2C protocol, the data transfer ends.
If the check feature is not enabled, when the R/W bit does not indicate a WRITE, the data transfer still continues, but transfer failure may occur.
